title: B1889 – Passenger Airbag Disable Module Sensor Obstructed
description: Passenger Airbag Disable Module Sensor Obstructed Diagnostic trouble code B1889. Confirm with a scan tool and vehicle-specific service data.
symptoms: Check engine light or stored DTC present

Wiring, connector, or control module issue

Clear codes only after repair and confirm monitors complete
